question: Can either of two exact open-line source/occurrence renaming leaves be received by the existing Rust research certificate merely by substituting its QualifiedOccurrence labels, without constructing and independently binding a native source snapshot, residual context and occurrence path?
objects: the minimal native zero-event fixture (frontier (use static) (use dynamic)) at Rational::ONE
its independently bound ExpectedRequest and valid ResearchCertificate
the exact open-line leaf s-KX-L/o-KX-L to open-reuse-s-KX-L/open-reuse-o-KX-L
the exact open-line leaf s-tK-R/o-tK-R to open-reuse-s-tK-R/open-reuse-o-tK-R
types: Rust-native CompilationArtifact, SharedProgramDiagram, ExpectedRequest, ResearchCertificate and QualifiedOccurrence; external open-line strings enter only as SourceId and OccurrenceId substitutions in a cloned certificate
quantifiers: One valid native positive control and both declared exact external leaf substitutions; no search and no additional cases
arithmetic_domain: Rational::ONE is an input-binding fixture value only; additive zero and multiplicative unity remain distinct typed notions and no arithmetic-universality judgment is made
candidate_grammar: Existing private research receiver only: receive(source artifact, residual artifact, proposed certificate, independently fixed expected request, structural budget)
evaluation: the unmodified native certificate is Certified under structural budget 512
the fixture has exactly one mapped dynamic occurrence
each external leaf substitution is Refused with the exact reason qualified source occurrence mismatch
the independently fixed source snapshot, residual context and occurrence path are not changed or reconstructed
stop: Retain any compile, positive-control, mismatch-reason, resource or workflow failure as Unknown or ImplementedNotRun. Do not create a serialized receiving API or reconstruct native identity in Python in this trial.
protected: Refusal of label substitution is not a proof that no bridge can be constructed
External string equality is not Rust semantic identity, source admission or input-binding evidence
No public or stable certificate schema is inferred from private test structs
No M6 filler, Close, free, Research 0090 coverage, Research 0092 promotion, arithmetic-universality or hypothesized-arithmetic-truth
No vocabulary is learned merely by registering this boundary test
residual: A bridge would still need a versioned receiving request carrying a validated native SharedProgramDiagram, qualified context, source/occurrence/path map and independently selected expected binding. This experiment neither designs nor validates that bridge.
